cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says government data or a core system is hosted in a national data centre or cloud.
cells.note: A 2025 report says Banco de Moçambique Notice 4/GGBM/2003, not repealed, requires data centres to be in Mozambique (MOZ-001), so stage 3. No source says government data is hosted in a national data centre, so not 4.
